name: todira-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods: a usage row above the prompt, right-to-left messages, and a hide-replies button.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A live row above the prompt: 5-hour and 7-day usage (used and left), context fill and session cost.

plugins.name: rtl-messages
plugins.description: Draws Hebrew and Arabic messages right-to-left, yours and Claude's. /rtl toggles it.

plugins.name: hide-replies
plugins.description: A button in the row above the prompt that collapses Claude's replies to one dim line each.
